svg.title: Quadrify regular and poled quad islands
svg.desc: Regular quad charts use exact integer grids; poled or concave quad islands use whole-island Quad-Flow DAG.. Actual add-on output on synthetic UV geometry. Preserves pins, existing constraints, island area, and zero flips/overlaps without adding UV seams.

g.text: Quadrify regular and poled quad islands
Regular quad charts use exact integer grids; poled or concave quad islands use whole-island Quad-Flow DAG.
Before · warped quad island with poles
Preserves pins, existing constraints, island area, and zero flips/overlaps without adding UV seams.
Synthetic mesh · genuine add-on results · shared scale in all panels · not a performance comparison
